title: Research: named-class C5 cancellation charge beats termwise 180/7 (floors 45 and 561/16; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6 answering the open OQ of [#3639](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3639): whether an explicit cancellation identity (beyond residual local-opt costs) can give a valid fit-level charge that beats the termwise `180/7` ceiling.

Among named term classes `{diagonal, J, off-diagonal, pairwise Gram}`, after identical-support opposite-sign netting, an explicit charging certificate with weights summing to `9/4` dominates every 1- and 2-plane support rectangle (`2,547,216` rectangles) and credits each remaining net full-support term by `159/16`. Fit-level floors:

| Case | Floor | vs `180/7` ≈ 25.71 |
|---|---:|---|
| J-free (`σ_J = 0`) | **45** | beats |
| one J (`σ_J = 1`) | **561/16** = 35.0625 | beats |

Diagonal tariff 224 and J-extension tariff 16097 meet the respective floors. Dual scanners agree. These are **named-class proof-method bounds** after netting + J credit — not a new unconditional / `Cost_opt` decoder floor. `beats=true` means beats the **termwise aggregation ceiling** `180/7` inside this certificate class; uncredited full-support on these weights still fails (`ρ = 303/16 > 9`).

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge/`

- Scope: **changed** — cancellation-identity charging after #3639

Closest priors: [#3639](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3639) (residual/local-opt fails; leave-alone), `c5-global-charging-obstruction` / `c5-global-charging-ceiling` (termwise `180/7`; leave-alone), `c5-four-residual-floors`. Soft-overlap with #3639 verify ≈0.59 (shared C5 geometry scaffold); scientific novelty is the named-support domination certificate and J-credit floors above `180/7`. Does not reprint residual `460>224` or the classical ceiling bill. Leave #3639 and termwise obstruction/ceiling packages alone. Local cost-20 theorems are granted, not replayed. Dual scanners agree on the census; the independent path does not re-tariff the J-extension fixture.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge/test_verify.py
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_C5_FIT_LEVEL_CANCELLATION_CHARGE cycles=23 weight_sum=9/4 J_free_floor=45 one_J_floor=561/16 termwise_ceiling=180/7 beats=true
PASS_C5_FIT_LEVEL_CANCELLATION_CHARGE_INDEPENDENT cycles=23 weight_sum=9/4 J_free_floor=45 one_J_floor=561/16 termwise_ceiling=180/7 beats=true
# test_verify: 9 tests OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/c5-fit-level-cancellation-charge outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Does a cost-preserving reduction eliminate net full-support terms from every named-class exact fit, so the J-free floor 45 applies universally in this class?
